checklist: Valid US Passport (valid for at least 3 months past stay)
Consular application form (fully completed and signed)
Declaration page authorizing criminal record checks in Portugal
FBI Criminal Record Background Check (Apostilled & Translated)
Valid Private Expat Health Insurance (covering repatriation)

Active Portuguese Bank Account with qualifying deposit funds (a minimum initial deposit required by a bank to activate a new checking or current account, where most standard brick-and-mortar institutions require an initial activation deposit ranging from €100 to €250, sometimes up to €500 for specialized non-resident or expat packages)
Proof of accommodation (12-month lease registered with AT)
Proof of financial resources (passive income statements or remote paystubs)
